### Core Channel Plugin System

**File:** `/Users/penso/.superset/worktrees/moltis/glistening-amazonsaurus/crates/channels/src/plugin.rs`

The channel plugin system is built on these core traits:

#### 1. **ChannelPlugin Trait** (async_trait)
Main interface each channel implements. Key methods:
- `fn id(&self) -> &str` - Channel identifier (e.g., "msteams")
- `fn name(&self) -> &str` - Human-readable name
- `async fn start_account(&mut self, account_id: &str, config: serde_json::Value) -> Result<()>`
- `async fn stop_account(&mut self, account_id: &str) -> Result<()>`
- `fn outbound(&self) -> Option<&dyn ChannelOutbound>` - Getter for sending messages
- `fn status(&self) -> Option<&dyn ChannelStatus>` - Getter for health checks
- `fn has_account(&self, account_id: &str) -> bool`
- `fn account_ids(&self) -> Vec<String>`
- `fn account_config(&self, account_id: &str) -> Option<Box<dyn ChannelConfigView>>`
- `fn update_account_config(&self, account_id: &str, config: serde_json::Value) -> Result<()>`
- `fn shared_outbound(&self) -> Arc<dyn ChannelOutbound>`
- `fn shared_stream_outbound(&self) -> Arc<dyn ChannelStreamOutbound>`
- `fn account_config_json(&self, account_id: &str) -> Option<serde_json::Value>` (with default)
- `fn channel_webhook_verifier(&self, account_id: &str) -> Option<Box<dyn ChannelWebhookVerifier>>` (with default, returns None)

#### 2. **ChannelOutbound Trait** (async_trait)
For sending messages:
- `async fn send_text(&self, account_id: &str, to: &str, text: &str, reply_to: Option<&str>) -> Result<()>`
- `async fn send_media(&self, account_id: &str, to: &str, payload: &ReplyPayload, reply_to: Option<&str>) -> Result<()>`
- `async fn send_typing(&self, account_id: &str, to: &str) -> Result<()>` (default: no-op)
- `async fn send_text_with_suffix(&self, account_id: &str, to: &str, text: &str, suffix_html: &str, reply_to: Option<&str>) -> Result<()>` (default: ignores suffix)
- `async fn send_html(&self, account_id: &str, to: &str, html: &str, reply_to: Option<&str>) -> Result<()>` (default: calls send_text)
- `async fn send_text_silent(&self, account_id: &str, to: &str, text: &str, reply_to: Option<&str>) -> Result<()>` (default: calls send_text)
- `async fn send_interactive(&self, account_id: &str, to: &str, message: &InteractiveMessage, reply_to: Option<&str>) -> Result<()>` (default: renders buttons as numbered text)
- `async fn add_reaction(&self, account_id: &str, channel_id: &str, message_id: &str, emoji: &str) -> Result<()>` (default: no-op)
- `async fn remove_reaction(&self, account_id: &str, channel_id: &str, message_id: &str, emoji: &str) -> Result<()>` (default: no-op)
- `async fn send_location(&self, account_id: &str, to: &str, latitude: f64, longitude: f64, title: Option<&str>, reply_to: Option<&str>) -> Result<()>` (default: no-op)

#### 3. **ChannelStreamOutbound Trait** (async_trait)
For streaming responses:
- `async fn send_stream(&self, account_id: &str, to: &str, reply_to: Option<&str>, stream: StreamReceiver) -> Result<()>`
- `async fn is_stream_enabled(&self, account_id: &str) -> bool` (default: true)

#### 4. **ChannelStatus Trait** (async_trait)
For health checks:
- `async fn probe(&self, account_id: &str) -> Result<ChannelHealthSnapshot>`

#### 5. **ChannelEventSink Trait** (async_trait)
Gateway-provided sink for channel events:
- `async fn emit(&self, event: ChannelEvent)` - Broadcast channel event
- `async fn dispatch_to_chat(&self, text: &str, reply_to: ChannelReplyTarget, meta: ChannelMessageMeta)` - Dispatch inbound message to session
- `async fn dispatch_command(&self, command: &str, reply_to: ChannelReplyTarget) -> Result<String>` - Dispatch slash command
- `async fn request_disable_account(&self, channel_type: &str, account_id: &str, reason: &str)` - Request account disabling
- `async fn request_sender_approval(&self, channel_type: &str, account_id: &str, identifier: &str)` (default: no-op)
- `async fn save_channel_voice(&self, audio_data: &[u8], filename: &str, reply_to: &ChannelReplyTarget) -> Option<String>` (default: None)
- `async fn transcribe_voice(&self, audio_data: &[u8], format: &str) -> Result<String>` (default: error)
- `async fn voice_stt_available(&self) -> bool` (default: true)
- `async fn update_location(&self, reply_to: &ChannelReplyTarget, latitude: f64, longitude: f64) -> bool` (default: false)
- `async fn resolve_pending_location(&self, reply_to: &ChannelReplyTarget, latitude: f64, longitude: f64) -> bool` (default: false)
- `async fn dispatch_interaction(&self, callback_data: &str, reply_to: ChannelReplyTarget) -> Result<String>` (default: error)
- `async fn dispatch_to_chat_with_attachments(&self, text: &str, attachments: Vec<ChannelAttachment>, reply_to: ChannelReplyTarget, meta: ChannelMessageMeta)` (default: ignores attachments)

#### 6. **ChannelConfigView Trait** (not async)
Read-only typed access to channel config:
- `fn allowlist(&self) -> &[String]`
- `fn group_allowlist(&self) -> &[String]`
- `fn dm_policy(&self) -> DmPolicy`
- `fn group_policy(&self) -> GroupPolicy`
- `fn model(&self) -> Option<&str>`
- `fn model_provider(&self) -> Option<&str>`
- `fn channel_model(&self, channel_id: &str) -> Option<&str>` (default: None)
- `fn channel_model_provider(&self, channel_id: &str) -> Option<&str>` (default: None)
- `fn user_model(&self, user_id: &str) -> Option<&str>` (default: None)
- `fn user_model_provider(&self, user_id: &str) -> Option<&str>` (default: None)
- `fn resolve_model(&self, channel_id: &str, user_id: &str) -> Option<&str>` (default: user > channel > account)
- `fn resolve_model_provider(&self, channel_id: &str, user_id: &str) -> Option<&str>` (default: user > channel > account)

### Webhook Middleware System

**File:** `/Users/penso/.superset/worktrees/moltis/glistening-amazonsaurus/crates/channels/src/channel_webhook_middleware.rs`

#### **ChannelWebhookVerifier Trait**
Each webhook-based channel implements this:
- `fn verify(&self, headers: &HeaderMap, body: &[u8]) -> Result<VerifiedChannelWebhook, ChannelWebhookRejection>`
  - Returns: `idempotency_key: Option<String>`, `body: Bytes`, `timestamp_epoch: Option<i64>`
- `fn max_timestamp_age(&self) -> Duration` (default: 5 minutes)
- `fn rate_policy(&self) -> ChannelWebhookRatePolicy` (default: 60 req/min, burst 10)
- `fn channel_type(&self) -> ChannelType`

#### **Webhook Rejection Reasons**
- `BadSignature(String)` - Signature verification failed
- `StaleTimestamp { age_seconds, max_seconds }` - Request too old/future
- `MissingHeaders(String)` - Required headers missing
- `Duplicate` - Idempotency key already seen
- `RateLimited { retry_after }` - Rate limit exceeded

### Gating and Access Control

**File:** `/Users/penso/.superset/worktrees/moltis/glistening-amazonsaurus/crates/channels/src/gating.rs`

Three enums for access control:
- **DmPolicy**: `Open` | `Allowlist` (default) | `Disabled`
- **GroupPolicy**: `Open` (default) | `Allowlist` | `Disabled`
- **MentionMode**: `Mention` (default) | `Always` | `None`

Plus `is_allowed(peer_id: &str, allowlist: &[String]) -> bool` helper supporting glob patterns (`*` wildcard).

### Activity Ingestion Flow

**File:** `/Users/penso/.superset/worktrees/moltis/glistening-amazonsaurus/crates/msteams/src/activity.rs`

```rust
pub struct TeamsActivity {
    pub activity_type: String,           // "message", etc.
    pub id: Option<String>,              // Idempotency key
    pub text: Option<String>,
    pub service_url: Option<String>,
    pub from: Option<ActivityAccount>,   // Sender
    pub recipient: Option<ActivityAccount>, // Bot
    pub conversation: Option<ActivityConversation>,
    pub entities: Option<Vec<ActivityEntity>>, // Mentions
    pub channel_data: Option<serde_json::Value>,
}
```

Key methods:
- `pub fn conversation_id(&self) -> Option<&str>`
- `pub fn sender_id(&self) -> Option<String>` - Prefers AAD object ID, falls back to ID
- `pub fn sender_name(&self) -> Option<String>`
- `pub fn is_group_chat(&self) -> bool` - Checks conversation_type and channel_data
- `pub fn bot_is_mentioned(&self) -> bool` - Checks entities for mention
- `pub fn cleaned_text(&self) -> Option<String>` - Removes `<at>` tags from @mentions

**Processing Flow (process_activity, lines 170-351):**
1. Extract account state, validate it exists
2. Store service_url for conversation if present
3. Ignore non-"message" activity types
4. Get cleaned text (no-op if no text)
5. Extract conversation ID, sender ID/name, group chat flag
6. Check access policy:
   - For groups: GroupPolicy + MentionMode
   - For DMs: DmPolicy + allowlist
7. Log to message_log if present
8. Emit `ChannelEvent::InboundMessage`
9. If access denied, return early
10. Create `ChannelReplyTarget` with channel_type, account_id, chat_id, message_id
11. If text starts with `/`, dispatch command via `event_sink.dispatch_command()`
12. Otherwise, dispatch to chat via `event_sink.dispatch_to_chat()` with `ChannelMessageMeta`

```

**ChannelWebhookVerifier implementation:**
- `fn verify(&self, headers: &HeaderMap, body: &[u8]) -> Result<VerifiedChannelWebhook, ...>` (lines 40-78):
  - Extracts `x-moltis-webhook-secret` header (injected by gateway from `?secret=...`)
  - Constant-time comparison if secret configured
  - Extracts idempotency key from JSON `id` field
  - Returns `VerifiedChannelWebhook { idempotency_key, body, timestamp_epoch: None }`
    - Teams doesn't provide timestamp header
- `fn channel_type(&self) -> ChannelType` returns `ChannelType::MsTeams`

## Webhook Handler in Gateway

**File:** `/Users/penso/.superset/worktrees/moltis/glistening-amazonsaurus/crates/httpd/src/server.rs` (lines 578-673)

Route: `POST /api/channels/msteams/{account_id}/webhook`

**Request handling:**
1. Extract `account_id` from path
2. Extract optional `?secret=...` from query string
3. Get webhook verifier from plugin: `plugin.channel_webhook_verifier(&account_id)`
4. If no verifier, return 404
5. Inject query secret as `x-moltis-webhook-secret` header
6. Run shared middleware: `channel_webhook_gate(verifier, dedup, rate_limiter, account_id, headers, body)`
7. Handle rejections (bad signature, rate limited, stale, etc.)
8. Handle deduplication (Duplicate → 200 OK)
9. On New event:
   - Parse verified body as JSON
   - Call plugin method: **`plugin.ingest_verified_activity(&account_id, payload).await`**
   - Return 200 if success, 400/404 if error

## Summary of Key Interfaces and Implementations

**Trait Implementations by MsTeamsPlugin:**
1. `ChannelPlugin` - Full implementation with webhook verifier support
2. `ChannelStatus` - Probe implementation (checks account existence and known conversations)

**Trait Implementations by MsTeamsOutbound:**
1. `ChannelOutbound` - Send text/media via Teams Bot Framework API
2. `ChannelStreamOutbound` - Streaming via edit-in-place (delegates to ChannelOutbound)

**Trait Implementations by MsTeamsAccountConfig:**
1. `ChannelConfigView` - Typed access to allowlist, policies, model settings

**Trait Implementations by TeamsChannelWebhookVerifier:**
1. `ChannelWebhookVerifier` - Shared-secret verification, idempotency key extraction

All files use `async_trait` for async method support and `serde_json::Value` for config persistence.

Classifies HTTP response status codes into retry categories following the\n//! same model as OpenClaw's `errors.ts`.\n\nuse std::time::Duration;\n\n/// Classification of a Teams send error.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq)]\npub enum SendErrorKind {\n    /// 401/403 — authentication failure, do not retry.\n    Auth,\n    /// 429 — rate limited, retry after backoff.\n    Throttled,\n    /// 408 or 5xx — transient failure, retry with exponential backoff.\n    Transient,\n    /// Other 4xx — permanent failure, do not retry.\n    Permanent,\n    /// No status code available (network error, etc.).\n    Unknown,\n}\n\n/// Full classification of a send error including retry hints.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct SendErrorClassification {\n    pub kind: SendErrorKind,\n    pub status_code: Option<u16>,\n    /// Server-suggested retry delay from the `Retry-After` header.\n    pub retry_after: Option<Duration>,\n}\n\n/// Classify an HTTP response status and extract retry hints.\npub fn classify_send_error(\n    status: reqwest::StatusCode,\n    headers: &reqwest::header::HeaderMap,\n) -> SendErrorClassification {\n    let retry_after = extract_retry_after(headers);\n    let code = status.as_u16();\n    let kind = match code {\n        401 | 403 => SendErrorKind::Auth,\n        429 => SendErrorKind::Throttled,\n        408 | 500..=599 => SendErrorKind::Transient,\n        400..=499 => SendErrorKind::Permanent,\n        _ => SendErrorKind::Unknown,\n    };\n    SendErrorClassification {\n        kind,\n        status_code: Some(code),\n        retry_after,\n    }\n}\n\n/// Whether the error kind is worth retrying.\npub fn should_retry(kind: SendErrorKind) -> bool {\n    matches!(kind, SendErrorKind::Throttled | SendErrorKind::Transient)\n}\n\n/// Compute delay for the next retry attempt.\n///\n/// Uses exponential backoff: `base_delay * 2^(attempt-1)`, clamped to\n/// `max_delay`. Respects server-provided `Retry-After` if it is longer.\npub fn compute_retry_delay(\n    attempt: u32,\n    classification: &SendErrorClassification,\n    base_delay: Duration,\n    max_delay: Duration,\n) -> Duration {\n    let exp_delay = base_delay.saturating_mul(1u32.wrapping_shl(attempt.saturating_sub(1)));\n    let backoff = exp_delay.min(max_delay);\n    match classification.retry_after {\n        Some(server_delay) if server_delay > backoff => server_delay.min(max_delay),\n        _ => backoff,\n    }\n}\n\nfn extract_retry_after(headers: &reqwest::header::HeaderMap) -> Option<Duration> {\n    let val = headers\n        .get(reqwest::header::RETRY_AFTER)\n        .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())?;\n    // Try parsing as integer seconds first.\n    if let Ok(secs) = val.parse::<u64>() {\n        return Some(Duration::from_secs(secs));\n    }\n    None\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\n#[allow(clippy::unwrap_used)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn classify_401_as_auth() {\n        let c = classify_send_error(\n            reqwest::StatusCode::UNAUTHORIZED,\n            &reqwest::header::HeaderMap::new(),\n        );\n        assert_eq!(c.kind, SendErrorKind::Auth);\n        assert!(!should_retry(c.kind));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn classify_403_as_auth() {\n        let c = classify_send_error(\n            reqwest::StatusCode::FORBIDDEN,\n            &reqwest::header::HeaderMap::new(),\n        );\n        assert_eq!(c.kind, SendErrorKind::Auth);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn classify_429_as_throttled() {\n        let mut headers = reqwest::header::HeaderMap::new();\n        headers.insert(reqwest::header::RETRY_AFTER, \"5\".parse().unwrap());\n        let c = classify_send_error(reqwest::StatusCode::TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, &headers);\n        assert_eq!(c.kind, SendErrorKind::Throttled);\n        assert!(should_retry(c.kind));\n        assert_eq!(c.retry_after, Some(Duration::from_secs(5)));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn classify_500_as_transient() {\n        let c = classify_send_error(\n            reqwest::StatusCode::INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,\n            &reqwest::header::HeaderMap::new(),\n        );\n        assert_eq!(c.kind, SendErrorKind::Transient);\n        assert!(should_retry(c.kind));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn classify_408_as_transient() {\n        let c = classify_send_error(\n            reqwest::StatusCode::REQUEST_TIMEOUT,\n            &reqwest::header::HeaderMap::new(),\n        );\n        assert_eq!(c.kind, SendErrorKind::Transient);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn classify_400_as_permanent() {\n        let c = classify_send_error(\n            reqwest::StatusCode::BAD_REQUEST,\n            &reqwest::header::HeaderMap::new(),\n        );\n        assert_eq!(c.kind, SendErrorKind::Permanent);\n        assert!(!should_retry(c.kind));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn compute_delay_exponential_backoff() {\n        let c = SendErrorClassification {\n            kind: SendErrorKind::Transient,\n            status_code: Some(500),\n            retry_after: None,\n        };\n        let base = Duration::from_millis(250);\n        let max = Duration::from_secs(10);\n        assert_eq!(compute_retry_delay(1, &c, base, max), Duration::from_millis(250));\n        assert_eq!(compute_retry_delay(2, &c, base, max), Duration::from_millis(500));\n        assert_eq!(compute_retry_delay(3, &c, base, max), Duration::from_secs(1));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn compute_delay_respects_retry_after() {\n        let c = SendErrorClassification {\n            kind: SendErrorKind::Throttled,\n            status_code: Some(429),\n            retry_after: Some(Duration::from_secs(8)),\n        };\n        let base = Duration::from_millis(250);\n        let max = Duration::from_secs(10);\n        // Server says 8s, which is larger than 250ms backoff.\n        assert_eq!(compute_retry_delay(1, &c, base, max), Duration::from_secs(8));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn compute_delay_clamps_to_max() {\n        let c = SendErrorClassification {\n            kind: SendErrorKind::Transient,\n            status_code: Some(500),\n            retry_after: None,\n        };\n        let base = Duration::from_secs(1);\n        let max = Duration::from_secs(5);\n        // 2^6 = 64s, clamped to 5s\n        assert_eq!(compute_retry_delay(7, &c, base, max), Duration::from_secs(5));\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "//! Message text chunking for Teams' message size limits.\n//!\n//! Teams truncates messages at approximately 28 KB, but a practical safe limit\n//! is 4000 characters. This module splits long messages at paragraph, line, or\n//! word boundaries.\n\n/// Default maximum characters per chunk for Teams messages.\npub const DEFAULT_CHUNK_LIMIT: usize = 4000;\n\n/// Split `text` into chunks of at most `max_len` characters.\n///\n/// Tries to split at paragraph boundaries (`\\n\\n`), then line boundaries\n/// (`\\n`), then the last space before the limit. Falls back to a hard cut\n/// at `max_len` if no split point is found.\npub fn chunk_message(text: &str, max_len: usize) -> Vec<&str> {\n    if max_len == 0 {\n        return vec![text];\n    }\n    if text.len() <= max_len {\n        return vec![text];\n    }\n\n    let mut chunks = Vec::new();\n    let mut remaining = text;\n\n    while !remaining.is_empty() {\n        if remaining.len() <= max_len {\n            chunks.push(remaining);\n            break;\n        }\n\n        let window = &remaining[..max_len];\n        let split_at = find_split_point(window);\n\n        let (chunk, rest) = remaining.split_at(split_at);\n        let chunk = chunk.trim_end();\n        if !chunk.is_empty() {\n            chunks.push(chunk);\n        }\n        remaining = rest.trim_start();\n    }\n\n    chunks\n}\n\nfn find_split_point(window: &str) -> usize {\n    // Prefer paragraph boundary.\n    if let Some(pos) = window.rfind(\"\\n\\n\") {\n        return pos;\n    }\n    // Then line boundary.\n    if let Some(pos) = window.rfind('\\n') {\n        return pos;\n    }\n    // Then last space.\n    if let Some(pos) = window.rfind(' ') {\n        return pos;\n    }\n    // Hard cut at char boundary.\n    floor_char_boundary(window, window.len())\n}\n\n/// Find the largest byte offset <= `pos` that falls on a UTF-8 character boundary.\nfn floor_char_boundary(s: &str, pos: usize) -> usize {\n    if pos >= s.len() {\n        return s.len();\n    }\n    let mut i = pos;\n    while i > 0 && !s.is_char_boundary(i) {\n        i -= 1;\n    }\n    i\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn empty_string() {\n        assert_eq!(chunk_message(\"\", 100), vec![\"\"]);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn under_limit() {\n        assert_eq!(chunk_message(\"hello world\", 100), vec![\"hello world\"]);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn exact_limit() {\n        let text = \"abcde\";\n        assert_eq!(chunk_message(text, 5), vec![\"abcde\"]);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn splits_at_paragraph() {\n        let text = \"first paragraph\\n\\nsecond paragraph\";\n        let chunks = chunk_message(text, 20);\n        assert_eq!(chunks, vec![\"first paragraph\", \"second paragraph\"]);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn splits_at_newline() {\n        let text = \"first line\\nsecond line that is longer\";\n        let chunks = chunk_message(text, 15);\n        assert_eq!(chunks[0], \"first line\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn splits_at_space() {\n        let text = \"word1 word2 word3 word4\";\n        let chunks = chunk_message(text, 11);\n        assert_eq!(chunks[0], \"word1 word2\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn hard_cut_no_space() {\n        let text = \"abcdefghijklmnop\";\n        let chunks = chunk_message(text, 5);\n        assert_eq!(chunks[0], \"abcde\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn multi_chunk() {\n        let text = \"aaaa bbbb cccc dddd\";\n        let chunks = chunk_message(text, 9);\n        assert!(chunks.len() >= 2);\n        for chunk in &chunks {\n            assert!(chunk.len() <= 9);\n        }\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn zero_limit_returns_whole() {\n        let text = \"hello world\";\n        assert_eq!(chunk_message(text, 0), vec![\"hello world\"]);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn unicode_safe() {\n        // Each emoji is 4 bytes\n        let text = \"\\u{1F600}\\u{1F600}\\u{1F600}\\u{1F600}\\u{1F600}\";\n        let chunks = chunk_message(text, 8); // fits exactly 2 emoji\n        assert!(chunks.len() >= 2);\n        for chunk in &chunks {\n            assert!(chunk.is_char_boundary(0));\n        }\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "//! Adaptive Card builders for Teams messages.\n//!\n//! Provides constructors for common card types: welcome cards, structured\n//! responses, and generic card attachments.\n\n/// Build an Adaptive Card attachment envelope for Bot Framework activities.\npub fn card_attachment(card: serde_json::Value) -> serde_json::Value {\n    serde_json::json!({\n        \"contentType\": \"application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive\",\n        \"content\": card,\n    })\n}\n\n/// Build a Bot Framework activity that sends an Adaptive Card.\npub fn card_activity(card: serde_json::Value, fallback_text: Option<&str>) -> serde_json::Value {\n    let mut activity = serde_json::json!({\n        \"type\": \"message\",\n        \"attachments\": [card_attachment(card)],\n    });\n    if let Some(text) = fallback_text {\n        activity[\"text\"] = serde_json::Value::String(text.to_string());\n    }\n    activity\n}\n\n/// Build a welcome card shown when a user first messages the bot in a DM.\npub fn build_welcome_card(bot_name: &str, prompt_starters: &[String]) -> serde_json::Value {\n    let mut body: Vec<serde_json::Value> = vec![serde_json::json!({\n        \"type\": \"TextBlock\",\n        \"size\": \"Medium\",\n        \"weight\": \"Bolder\",\n        \"text\": format!(\"Welcome to {bot_name}!\"),\n        \"wrap\": true,\n    })];\n\n    if !prompt_starters.is_empty() {\n        body.push(serde_json::json!({\n            \"type\": \"TextBlock\",\n            \"text\": \"Try one of these to get started:\",\n            \"wrap\": true,\n            \"spacing\": \"Medium\",\n        }));\n\n        for starter in prompt_starters {\n            body.push(serde_json::json!({\n                \"type\": \"ActionSet\",\n                \"actions\": [{\n                    \"type\": \"Action.Submit\",\n                    \"title\": starter,\n                    \"data\": { \"msteams\": { \"type\": \"imBack\", \"value\": starter } },\n                }],\n            }));\n        }\n    } else {\n        body.push(serde_json::json!({\n            \"type\": \"TextBlock\",\n            \"text\": \"Send me a message to get started.\",\n            \"wrap\": true,\n            \"spacing\": \"Medium\",\n        }));\n    }\n\n    serde_json::json!({\n        \"type\": \"AdaptiveCard\",\n        \"$schema\": \"http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json\",\n        \"version\": \"1.4\",\n        \"body\": body,\n    })\n}\n\n/// Build a simple text for group welcome messages (not a card, just text).\npub fn build_group_welcome_text(bot_name: &str) -> String {\n    format!(\"Hi! I'm {bot_name}. Mention me with @{bot_name} and I'll respond to your message.\")\n}\n\n/// Build a poll card with multiple choice options.\npub fn build_poll_card(question: &str, options: &[String], max_selections: u32) -> serde_json::Value {\n    let mut choices: Vec<serde_json::Value> = Vec::with_capacity(options.len());\n    for (i, opt) in options.iter().enumerate() {\n        choices.push(serde_json::json!({\n            \"title\": opt,\n            \"value\": i.to_string(),\n        }));\n    }\n\n    let is_multi = max_selections > 1;\n\n    serde_json::json!({\n        \"type\": \"AdaptiveCard\",\n        \"$schema\": \"http://adaptivecards.io/schemas/adaptive-card.json\",\n        \"version\": \"1.4\",\n        \"body\": [\n            {\n                \"type\": \"TextBlock\",\n                \"text\": question,\n                \"weight\": \"Bolder\",\n                \"size\": \"Medium\",\n                \"wrap\": true,\n            },\n            {\n                \"type\": \"Input.ChoiceSet\",\n                \"id\": \"poll_choice\",\n                \"style\": \"expanded\",\n                \"isMultiSelect\": is_multi,\n                \"choices\": choices,\n            }\n        ],\n        \"actions\": [{\n            \"type\": \"Action.Submit\",\n            \"title\": \"Vote\",\n            \"data\": { \"action\": \"poll_vote\" },\n        }],\n    })\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn card_attachment_has_correct_content_type() {\n        let card = serde_json::json!({\"type\": \"AdaptiveCard\"});\n        let att = card_attachment(card);\n        assert_eq!(\n            att[\"contentType\"],\n            \"application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive\"\n        );\n        assert_eq!(att[\"content\"][\"type\"], \"AdaptiveCard\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn card_activity_includes_attachment() {\n        let card = serde_json::json!({\"type\": \"AdaptiveCard\"});\n        let activity = card_activity(card, Some(\"fallback\"));\n        assert_eq!(activity[\"type\"], \"message\");\n        assert_eq!(activity[\"text\"], \"fallback\");\n        assert!(activity[\"attachments\"].is_array());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn welcome_card_with_starters() {\n        let card = build_welcome_card(\"TestBot\", &[\"Hello\".into(), \"Help\".into()]);\n        assert_eq!(card[\"type\"], \"AdaptiveCard\");\n        let body = card[\"body\"].as_array().unwrap();\n        // Title + instruction + 2 action sets\n        assert_eq!(body.len(), 4);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn welcome_card_no_starters() {\n        let card = build_welcome_card(\"TestBot\", &[]);\n        let body = card[\"body\"].as_array().unwrap();\n        // Title + default text\n        assert_eq!(body.len(), 2);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn poll_card_has_choices() {\n        let card = build_poll_card(\"Favorite?\", &[\"A\".into(), \"B\".into(), \"C\".into()], 1);\n        let body = card[\"body\"].as_array().unwrap();\n        let choice_set = &body[1];\n        assert_eq!(choice_set[\"type\"], \"Input.ChoiceSet\");\n        assert_eq!(choice_set[\"choices\"].as_array().unwrap().len(), 3);\n        assert_eq!(choice_set[\"isMultiSelect\"], false);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn poll_card_multi_select() {\n        let card = build_poll_card(\"Pick two\", &[\"X\".into(), \"Y\".into()], 2);\n        let body = card[\"body\"].as_array().unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(body[1][\"isMultiSelect\"], true);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn group_welcome_text_includes_name() {\n        let text = build_group_welcome_text(\"MyBot\");\n        assert!(text.contains(\"MyBot\"));\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "//! Bot Framework JWT token validation.\n//!\n//! Validates Bearer tokens sent by the Teams Bot Connector using JWKS\n//! (JSON Web Key Sets) from Microsoft's well-known endpoints. Supports both\n//! the Bot Framework issuer and the Entra (Azure AD) issuer.\n\nuse std::{\n    sync::Arc,\n    time::{Duration, Instant},\n};\n\nuse {\n    jsonwebtoken::{\n        Algorithm, DecodingKey, Validation,\n        jwk::{AlgorithmParameters, JwkSet},\n    },\n    tracing::{debug, warn},\n};\n\n/// Bot Framework JWKS endpoint.\nconst BOT_FRAMEWORK_JWKS_URL: &str =\n    \"https://login.botframework.com/v1/.well-known/keys\";\n\n/// Entra (Azure AD) common JWKS endpoint.\nconst ENTRA_JWKS_URL: &str =\n    \"https://login.microsoftonline.com/common/discovery/v2.0/keys\";\n\n/// Bot Framework token issuer.\nconst BOT_FRAMEWORK_ISSUER: &str = \"https://api.botframework.com\";\n\n/// How long to cache JWKS before re-fetching.\nconst JWKS_CACHE_TTL: Duration = Duration::from_secs(300);\n\n/// Cached JWKS key set with TTL.\nstruct CachedJwks {\n    keys: JwkSet,\n    fetched_at: Instant,\n}\n\nimpl CachedJwks {\n    fn is_fresh(&self) -> bool {\n        self.fetched_at.elapsed() < JWKS_CACHE_TTL\n    }\n}\n\n/// Validates Bot Framework JWT tokens from the `Authorization` header.\npub struct BotFrameworkJwtValidator {\n    app_id: String,\n    tenant_id: Option<String>,\n    http: reqwest::Client,\n    bot_framework_jwks: Arc<tokio::sync::RwLock<Option<CachedJwks>>>,\n    entra_jwks: Arc<tokio::sync::RwLock<Option<CachedJwks>>>,\n}\n\nimpl BotFrameworkJwtValidator {\n    pub fn new(app_id: String, tenant_id: Option<String>, http: reqwest::Client) -> Self {\n        Self {\n            app_id,\n            tenant_id,\n            http,\n            bot_framework_jwks: Arc::new(tokio::sync::RwLock::new(None)),\n            entra_jwks: Arc::new(tokio::sync::RwLock::new(None)),\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Validate a JWT from the `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header.\n    ///\n    /// Returns `true` if the token is valid (signature, audience, issuer,\n    /// expiry all check out).\n    pub async fn validate(&self, auth_header: &str) -> bool {\n        let token = match auth_header.strip_prefix(\"Bearer \") {\n            Some(t) => t.trim(),\n            None => {\n                debug!(\"Teams JWT: missing Bearer prefix\");\n                return false;\n            },\n        };\n\n        if token.is_empty() {\n            debug!(\"Teams JWT: empty token\");\n            return false;\n        }\n\n        // Decode header to find the key ID.\n        let header = match jsonwebtoken::decode_header(token) {\n            Ok(h) => h,\n            Err(e) => {\n                debug!(\"Teams JWT: invalid header: {e}\");\n                return false;\n            },\n        };\n\n        let kid = match header.kid.as_deref() {\n            Some(k) => k,\n            None => {\n                debug!(\"Teams JWT: no kid in header\");\n                return false;\n            },\n        };\n\n        // Try Bot Framework issuer first.\n        if let Some(result) = self\n            .try_validate_with_jwks(token, kid, BOT_FRAMEWORK_JWKS_URL, &self.bot_framework_jwks, BOT_FRAMEWORK_ISSUER)\n            .await\n        {\n            return result;\n        }\n\n        // Try Entra issuer.\n        let entra_issuer = self.entra_issuer();\n        if let Some(result) = self\n            .try_validate_with_jwks(token, kid, ENTRA_JWKS_URL, &self.entra_jwks, &entra_issuer)\n            .await\n        {\n            return result;\n        }\n\n        debug!(\"Teams JWT: kid '{kid}' not found in any JWKS\");\n        false\n    }\n\n    async fn try_validate_with_jwks(\n        &self,\n        token: &str,\n        kid: &str,\n        jwks_url: &str,\n        cache: &Arc<tokio::sync::RwLock<Option<CachedJwks>>>,\n        expected_issuer: &str,\n    ) -> Option<bool> {\n        let jwks = self.get_or_fetch_jwks(jwks_url, cache).await?;\n\n        let jwk = jwks.keys.iter().find(|k| {\n            k.common.key_id.as_deref() == Some(kid)\n        })?;\n\n        let decoding_key = match &jwk.algorithm {\n            AlgorithmParameters::RSA(rsa) => {\n                DecodingKey::from_rsa_components(&rsa.n, &rsa.e).ok()?\n            },\n            _ => {\n                debug!(\"Teams JWT: unsupported algorithm for kid '{kid}'\");\n                return Some(false);\n            },\n        };\n\n        let mut validation = Validation::new(Algorithm::RS256);\n        validation.set_audience(&[&self.app_id]);\n        validation.set_issuer(&[expected_issuer]);\n        // Also accept common Entra issuers.\n        validation.validate_exp = true;\n\n        match jsonwebtoken::decode::<serde_json::Value>(token, &decoding_key, &validation) {\n            Ok(_) => Some(true),\n            Err(e) => {\n                debug!(\"Teams JWT: validation failed with issuer {expected_issuer}: {e}\");\n                Some(false)\n            },\n        }\n    }\n\n    async fn get_or_fetch_jwks(\n        &self,\n        url: &str,\n        cache: &Arc<tokio::sync::RwLock<Option<CachedJwks>>>,\n    ) -> Option<Arc<JwkSet>> {\n        // Check cache.\n        {\n            let guard = cache.read().await;\n            if let Some(cached) = guard.as_ref() {\n                if cached.is_fresh() {\n                    return Some(Arc::new(cached.keys.clone()));\n                }\n            }\n        }\n\n        // Fetch new JWKS.\n        let jwks = match self.fetch_jwks(url).await {\n            Ok(keys) => keys,\n            Err(e) => {\n                warn!(\"Teams JWT: failed to fetch JWKS from {url}: {e}\");\n                return None;\n            },\n        };\n\n        let result = Arc::new(jwks.clone());\n\n        // Update cache.\n        let mut guard = cache.write().await;\n        *guard = Some(CachedJwks {\n            keys: jwks,\n            fetched_at: Instant::now(),\n        });\n\n        Some(result)\n    }\n\n    async fn fetch_jwks(&self, url: &str) -> anyhow::Result<JwkSet> {\n        let resp = self\n            .http\n            .get(url)\n            .timeout(Duration::from_secs(10))\n            .send()\n            .await?;\n\n        if !resp.status().is_success() {\n            anyhow::bail!(\"JWKS fetch returned {}\", resp.status());\n        }\n\n        let jwks: JwkSet = resp.json().await?;\n        Ok(jwks)\n    }\n\n    fn entra_issuer(&self) -> String {\n        match self.tenant_id.as_deref() {\n            Some(tid) if !tid.is_empty() && tid != \"botframework.com\" => {\n                format!(\"https://sts.windows.net/{tid}/\")\n            },\n            _ => \"https://sts.windows.net/botframework.com/\".to_string(),\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn entra_issuer_with_tenant() {\n        let v = BotFrameworkJwtValidator::new(\n            \"app\".into(),\n            Some(\"my-tenant-id\".into()),\n            reqwest::Client::new(),\n        );\n        assert_eq!(\n            v.entra_issuer(),\n            \"https://sts.windows.net/my-tenant-id/\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn entra_issuer_default() {\n        let v = BotFrameworkJwtValidator::new(\"app\".into(), None, reqwest::Client::new());\n        assert_eq!(\n            v.entra_issuer(),\n            \"https://sts.windows.net/botframework.com/\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn entra_issuer_botframework_tenant() {\n        let v = BotFrameworkJwtValidator::new(\n            \"app\".into(),\n            Some(\"botframework.com\".into()),\n            reqwest::Client::new(),\n        );\n        assert_eq!(\n            v.entra_issuer(),\n            \"https://sts.windows.net/botframework.com/\"\n        );\n    }\n\n    #[tokio::test]\n    async fn validate_rejects_empty_bearer() {\n        let v = BotFrameworkJwtValidator::new(\"app\".into(), None, reqwest::Client::new());\n        assert!(!v.validate(\"Bearer \").await);\n    }\n\n    #[tokio::test]\n    async fn validate_rejects_no_bearer_prefix() {\n        let v = BotFrameworkJwtValidator::new(\"app\".into(), None, reqwest::Client::new());\n        assert!(!v.validate(\"Basic abc123\").await);\n    }\n\n    #[tokio::test]\n    async fn validate_rejects_garbage_token() {\n        let v = BotFrameworkJwtValidator::new(\"app\".into(), None, reqwest::Client::new());\n        assert!(!v.validate(\"Bearer not.a.jwt\").await);\n    }\n}\n"
}

Provides thread context (message history), reactions, and message management\n//! via the Microsoft Graph API.\n\nuse {secrecy::ExposeSecret, tracing::debug};\n\nconst GRAPH_API_BASE: &str = \"https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0\";\nconst GRAPH_API_BETA: &str = \"https://graph.microsoft.com/beta\";\n\n/// A message from the Graph API.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct GraphMessage {\n    pub id: String,\n    pub body_content: Option<String>,\n    pub from_user_id: Option<String>,\n    pub from_user_name: Option<String>,\n    pub is_bot: bool,\n    pub created_at: Option<String>,\n}\n\n/// Summary of reactions on a message.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone)]\npub struct ReactionSummary {\n    pub reaction_type: String,\n    pub user_name: Option<String>,\n}\n\n/// Valid Teams reaction types.\npub const TEAMS_REACTION_TYPES: &[&str] = &[\"like\", \"heart\", \"laugh\", \"surprised\", \"sad\", \"angry\"];\n\n/// Fetch recent messages from a chat via Graph API.\npub async fn fetch_chat_messages(\n    http: &reqwest::Client,\n    token: &secrecy::Secret<String>,\n    chat_id: &str,\n    limit: usize,\n) -> anyhow::Result<Vec<GraphMessage>> {\n    let url = format!(\n        \"{GRAPH_API_BASE}/chats/{}/messages?$top={limit}&$orderby=createdDateTime desc\",\n        urlencoding::encode(chat_id),\n    );\n\n    let resp = http\n        .get(&url)\n        .bearer_auth(token.expose_secret())\n        .send()\n        .await?;\n\n    if !resp.status().is_success() {\n        let status = resp.status();\n        let body = resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default();\n        anyhow::bail!(\"Graph API fetch messages failed ({status}): {body}\");\n    }\n\n    let json: serde_json::Value = resp.json().await?;\n    let messages = json[\"value\"]\n        .as_array()\n        .map(|arr| {\n            arr.iter()\n                .filter_map(parse_graph_message)\n                .collect()\n        })\n        .unwrap_or_default();\n\n    Ok(messages)\n}\n\n/// Add a reaction to a message via Graph API (beta).\npub async fn add_reaction(\n    http: &reqwest::Client,\n    token: &secrecy::Secret<String>,\n    chat_id: &str,\n    message_id: &str,\n    reaction_type: &str,\n) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    if !TEAMS_REACTION_TYPES.contains(&reaction_type) {\n        anyhow::bail!(\n            \"unsupported reaction type '{reaction_type}'; valid types: {}\",\n            TEAMS_REACTION_TYPES.join(\", \")\n        );\n    }\n\n    let url = format!(\n        \"{GRAPH_API_BETA}/chats/{}/messages/{}/setReaction\",\n        urlencoding::encode(chat_id),\n        urlencoding::encode(message_id),\n    );\n\n    let resp = http\n        .post(&url)\n        .bearer_auth(token.expose_secret())\n        .json(&serde_json::json!({ \"reactionType\": reaction_type }))\n        .send()\n        .await?;\n\n    if !resp.status().is_success() {\n        let status = resp.status();\n        let body = resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default();\n        anyhow::bail!(\"Graph API setReaction failed ({status}): {body}\");\n    }\n\n    debug!(chat_id, message_id, reaction_type, \"reaction added\");\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// Remove a reaction from a message via Graph API (beta).\npub async fn remove_reaction(\n    http: &reqwest::Client,\n    token: &secrecy::Secret<String>,\n    chat_id: &str,\n    message_id: &str,\n    reaction_type: &str,\n) -> anyhow::Result<()> {\n    let url = format!(\n        \"{GRAPH_API_BETA}/chats/{}/messages/{}/unsetReaction\",\n        urlencoding::encode(chat_id),\n        urlencoding::encode(message_id),\n    );\n\n    let resp = http\n        .post(&url)\n        .bearer_auth(token.expose_secret())\n        .json(&serde_json::json!({ \"reactionType\": reaction_type }))\n        .send()\n        .await?;\n\n    if !resp.status().is_success() {\n        let status = resp.status();\n        let body = resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default();\n        anyhow::bail!(\"Graph API unsetReaction failed ({status}): {body}\");\n    }\n\n    Ok(())\n}\n\n/// List reactions on a message via Graph API.\npub async fn list_reactions(\n    http: &reqwest::Client,\n    token: &secrecy::Secret<String>,\n    chat_id: &str,\n    message_id: &str,\n) -> anyhow::Result<Vec<ReactionSummary>> {\n    let url = format!(\n        \"{GRAPH_API_BASE}/chats/{}/messages/{}\",\n        urlencoding::encode(chat_id),\n        urlencoding::encode(message_id),\n    );\n\n    let resp = http\n        .get(&url)\n        .bearer_auth(token.expose_secret())\n        .send()\n        .await?;\n\n    if !resp.status().is_success() {\n        let status = resp.status();\n        let body = resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default();\n        anyhow::bail!(\"Graph API get message failed ({status}): {body}\");\n    }\n\n    let json: serde_json::Value = resp.json().await?;\n    let reactions = json[\"reactions\"]\n        .as_array()\n        .map(|arr| {\n            arr.iter()\n                .filter_map(|r| {\n                    Some(ReactionSummary {\n                        reaction_type: r[\"reactionType\"].as_str()?.to_string(),\n                        user_name: r[\"user\"][\"displayName\"].as_str().map(String::from),\n                    })\n                })\n                .collect()\n        })\n        .unwrap_or_default();\n\n    Ok(reactions)\n}\n\nfn parse_graph_message(msg: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<GraphMessage> {\n    let id = msg[\"id\"].as_str()?.to_string();\n    let body_content = msg[\"body\"][\"content\"].as_str().map(String::from);\n    let from = &msg[\"from\"];\n    let from_user_id = from[\"user\"][\"id\"].as_str().map(String::from);\n    let from_user_name = from[\"user\"][\"displayName\"]\n        .as_str()\n        .or_else(|| from[\"application\"][\"displayName\"].as_str())\n        .map(String::from);\n    let is_bot = from[\"application\"].is_object();\n    let created_at = msg[\"createdDateTime\"].as_str().map(String::from);\n\n    Some(GraphMessage {\n        id,\n        body_content,\n        from_user_id,\n        from_user_name,\n        is_bot,\n        created_at,\n    })\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn parse_graph_message_basic() {\n        let json = serde_json::json!({\n            \"id\": \"msg-1\",\n            \"body\": { \"content\": \"hello world\" },\n            \"from\": {\n                \"user\": { \"id\": \"user-1\", \"displayName\": \"Alice\" }\n            },\n            \"createdDateTime\": \"2026-01-01T00:00:00Z\",\n        });\n        let msg = parse_graph_message(&json).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(msg.id, \"msg-1\");\n        assert_eq!(msg.body_content.as_deref(), Some(\"hello world\"));\n        assert_eq!(msg.from_user_id.as_deref(), Some(\"user-1\"));\n        assert_eq!(msg.from_user_name.as_deref(), Some(\"Alice\"));\n        assert!(!msg.is_bot);\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn parse_graph_message_bot() {\n        let json = serde_json::json!({\n            \"id\": \"msg-2\",\n            \"body\": { \"content\": \"bot reply\" },\n            \"from\": {\n                \"application\": { \"id\": \"app-1\", \"displayName\": \"Bot\" }\n            },\n            \"createdDateTime\": \"2026-01-01T00:01:00Z\",\n        });\n        let msg = parse_graph_message(&json).unwrap();\n        assert!(msg.is_bot);\n        assert_eq!(msg.from_user_name.as_deref(), Some(\"Bot\"));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn parse_graph_message_missing_id_returns_none() {\n        let json = serde_json::json!({\n            \"body\": { \"content\": \"no id\" },\n        });\n        assert!(parse_graph_message(&json).is_none());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn reaction_type_validation() {\n        assert!(TEAMS_REACTION_TYPES.contains(&\"like\"));\n        assert!(TEAMS_REACTION_TYPES.contains(&\"heart\"));\n        assert!(!TEAMS_REACTION_TYPES.contains(&\"thumbsup\"));\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "//! Inbound attachment downloading and outbound media handling.\n//!\n//! Handles downloading file attachments from inbound Teams messages and\n//! building outbound media activities with proper attachment encoding.\n\nuse {\n    base64::{Engine, engine::general_purpose::STANDARD as BASE64},\n    secrecy::ExposeSecret,\n    tracing::{debug, warn},\n};\n\n/// An attachment from an inbound Teams activity.\n#[derive(Debug, Clone, serde::Deserialize)]\npub struct ActivityAttachment {\n    /// Attachment content type (e.g., \"image/png\", \"application/pdf\").\n    #[serde(rename = \"contentType\")]\n    pub content_type: Option<String>,\n\n    /// URL to download the attachment content.\n    #[serde(rename = \"contentUrl\")]\n    pub content_url: Option<String>,\n\n    /// Attachment filename.\n    pub name: Option<String>,\n\n    /// Inline content (for Adaptive Card attachments, etc.).\n    pub content: Option<serde_json::Value>,\n}\n\n/// Downloaded attachment data.\n#[derive(Debug)]\npub struct DownloadedAttachment {\n    pub media_type: String,\n    pub data: Vec<u8>,\n    pub filename: Option<String>,\n}\n\n/// Maximum attachment download size (50 MB).\nconst MAX_DOWNLOAD_SIZE: usize = 50 * 1024 * 1024;\n\n/// Download an attachment from its content URL using the bot's access token.\npub async fn download_attachment(\n    http: &reqwest::Client,\n    token: &secrecy::Secret<String>,\n    attachment: &ActivityAttachment,\n) -> anyhow::Result<Option<DownloadedAttachment>> {\n    let url = match attachment.content_url.as_deref() {\n        Some(u) if !u.is_empty() => u,\n        _ => return Ok(None),\n    };\n\n    // Skip non-downloadable attachments (like Adaptive Cards).\n    let content_type = attachment\n        .content_type\n        .as_deref()\n        .unwrap_or(\"application/octet-stream\");\n    if content_type.starts_with(\"application/vnd.microsoft.card.\") {\n        return Ok(None);\n    }\n\n    debug!(url, \"downloading Teams attachment\");\n\n    let resp = http\n        .get(url)\n        .bearer_auth(token.expose_secret())\n        .send()\n        .await?;\n\n    if !resp.status().is_success() {\n        let status = resp.status();\n        warn!(url, %status, \"failed to download Teams attachment\");\n        return Ok(None);\n    }\n\n    // Check content length.\n    if let Some(len) = resp.content_length() {\n        if len as usize > MAX_DOWNLOAD_SIZE {\n            warn!(url, len, \"Teams attachment too large, skipping\");\n            return Ok(None);\n        }\n    }\n\n    let actual_type = resp\n        .headers()\n        .get(reqwest::header::CONTENT_TYPE)\n        .and_then(|v| v.to_str().ok())\n        .unwrap_or(content_type)\n        .to_string();\n\n    let data = resp.bytes().await?.to_vec();\n    if data.len() > MAX_DOWNLOAD_SIZE {\n        warn!(url, size = data.len(), \"Teams attachment exceeded max size\");\n        return Ok(None);\n    }\n\n    Ok(Some(DownloadedAttachment {\n        media_type: actual_type,\n        data,\n        filename: attachment.name.clone(),\n    }))\n}\n\n/// Build a Bot Framework attachment for sending an image inline (base64).\n///\n/// Works for DM chats. Group chats may need SharePoint/OneDrive instead.\npub fn build_inline_image_attachment(\n    data: &[u8],\n    media_type: &str,\n) -> serde_json::Value {\n    let b64 = BASE64.encode(data);\n    let data_url = format!(\"data:{media_type};base64,{b64}\");\n    serde_json::json!({\n        \"contentType\": media_type,\n        \"contentUrl\": data_url,\n    })\n}\n\n/// Build a Bot Framework activity with an inline image attachment.\npub fn build_media_activity(\n    text: &str,\n    data: &[u8],\n    media_type: &str,\n    reply_to: Option<&str>,\n) -> serde_json::Value {\n    let attachment = build_inline_image_attachment(data, media_type);\n    let mut activity = serde_json::json!({\n        \"type\": \"message\",\n        \"attachments\": [attachment],\n    });\n    if !text.is_empty() {\n        activity[\"text\"] = serde_json::Value::String(text.to_string());\n    }\n    if let Some(reply_id) = reply_to {\n        activity[\"replyToId\"] = serde_json::Value::String(reply_id.to_string());\n    }\n    activity\n}\n\n/// Check if a content type represents an image that can be sent inline.\npub fn is_inline_image(content_type: &str) -> bool {\n    content_type.starts_with(\"image/\")\n}\n\n/// Build a URL-based attachment (for external URLs).\npub fn build_url_attachment(url: &str, content_type: &str, name: Option<&str>) -> serde_json::Value {\n    let mut att = serde_json::json!({\n        \"contentType\": content_type,\n        \"contentUrl\": url,\n    });\n    if let Some(n) = name {\n        att[\"name\"] = serde_json::Value::String(n.to_string());\n    }\n    att\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn inline_image_attachment_format() {\n        let data = b\"fake-png-data\";\n        let att = build_inline_image_attachment(data, \"image/png\");\n        assert_eq!(att[\"contentType\"], \"image/png\");\n        let url = att[\"contentUrl\"].as_str().unwrap();\n        assert!(url.starts_with(\"data:image/png;base64,\"));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn media_activity_with_text() {\n        let activity = build_media_activity(\"caption\", b\"data\", \"image/jpeg\", Some(\"reply-1\"));\n        assert_eq!(activity[\"type\"], \"message\");\n        assert_eq!(activity[\"text\"], \"caption\");\n        assert_eq!(activity[\"replyToId\"], \"reply-1\");\n        assert!(activity[\"attachments\"].is_array());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn media_activity_no_text() {\n        let activity = build_media_activity(\"\", b\"data\", \"image/png\", None);\n        assert!(activity.get(\"text\").is_none());\n        assert!(activity.get(\"replyToId\").is_none());\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn is_inline_image_check() {\n        assert!(is_inline_image(\"image/png\"));\n        assert!(is_inline_image(\"image/jpeg\"));\n        assert!(!is_inline_image(\"application/pdf\"));\n        assert!(!is_inline_image(\"text/plain\"));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn url_attachment_with_name() {\n        let att = build_url_attachment(\"https://example.com/file.pdf\", \"application/pdf\", Some(\"report.pdf\"));\n        assert_eq!(att[\"contentType\"], \"application/pdf\");\n        assert_eq!(att[\"contentUrl\"], \"https://example.com/file.pdf\");\n        assert_eq!(att[\"name\"], \"report.pdf\");\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn deserialize_activity_attachment() {\n        let json = serde_json::json!({\n            \"contentType\": \"image/png\",\n            \"contentUrl\": \"https://example.com/image.png\",\n            \"name\": \"screenshot.png\",\n        });\n        let att: ActivityAttachment = serde_json::from_value(json).unwrap();\n        assert_eq!(att.content_type.as_deref(), Some(\"image/png\"));\n        assert_eq!(att.name.as_deref(), Some(\"screenshot.png\"));\n    }\n}\n"
}

  "content": "//! Edit-in-place streaming for Teams messages.\n//!\n//! Uses the Bot Framework activity update API to progressively edit a message\n//! as LLM tokens arrive, providing real-time streaming UX similar to\n//! ChatGPT/Claude web interfaces.\n//!\n//! Protocol:\n//! 1. Post initial message with accumulated text + \"...\"\n//! 2. PATCH the same activity at throttled intervals with more text\n//! 3. Final PATCH with complete text (no \"...\" suffix)\n\nuse std::time::{Duration, Instant};\n\nuse tracing::debug;\n\n/// Minimum characters before posting the initial message.\npub const MIN_INITIAL_CHARS: usize = 20;\n\n/// Default throttle between edits (Teams recommends 1.5-2s).\npub const DEFAULT_EDIT_THROTTLE: Duration = Duration::from_millis(1500);\n\n/// Streaming suffix appended during in-progress streaming.\nconst STREAMING_SUFFIX: &str = \" ...\";\n\n/// Manages the state of an edit-in-place streaming session.\npub struct StreamSession {\n    accumulated: String,\n    activity_id: Option<String>,\n    last_edit: Option<Instant>,\n    throttle: Duration,\n    finalized: bool,\n}\n\nimpl StreamSession {\n    pub fn new(throttle: Duration) -> Self {\n        Self {\n            accumulated: String::new(),\n            activity_id: None,\n            last_edit: None,\n            throttle,\n            finalized: false,\n        }\n    }\n\n    /// Append a text delta to the accumulated text.\n    pub fn push_delta(&mut self, delta: &str) {\n        self.accumulated.push_str(delta);\n    }\n\n    /// Whether the session has enough text to post the initial message.\n    pub fn ready_for_initial_post(&self) -> bool {\n        self.activity_id.is_none() && self.accumulated.len() >= MIN_INITIAL_CHARS\n    }\n\n    /// Whether enough time has passed to send an edit update.\n    pub fn ready_for_edit(&self) -> bool {\n        self.activity_id.is_some()\n            && !self.finalized\n            && self\n                .last_edit\n                .is_none_or(|t| t.elapsed() >= self.throttle)\n    }\n\n    /// Set the activity ID from the initial post response.\n    pub fn set_activity_id(&mut self, id: String) {\n        self.activity_id = Some(id);\n        self.last_edit = Some(Instant::now());\n    }\n\n    /// Get the activity ID (for updates).\n    pub fn activity_id(&self) -> Option<&str> {\n        self.activity_id.as_deref()\n    }\n\n    /// Get accumulated text with the streaming suffix.\n    pub fn text_with_suffix(&self) -> String {\n        let mut text = self.accumulated.clone();\n        text.push_str(STREAMING_SUFFIX);\n        text\n    }\n\n    /// Get the final accumulated text (no suffix).\n    pub fn final_text(&self) -> &str {\n        &self.accumulated\n    }\n\n    /// Whether the stream has any accumulated text.\n    pub fn has_text(&self) -> bool {\n        !self.accumulated.is_empty()\n    }\n\n    /// Mark this stream session as finalized.\n    pub fn finalize(&mut self) {\n        self.finalized = true;\n    }\n\n    /// Record that an edit was sent.\n    pub fn mark_edited(&mut self) {\n        self.last_edit = Some(Instant::now());\n    }\n\n    /// Whether the session is finalized.\n    pub fn is_finalized(&self) -> bool {\n        self.finalized\n    }\n}\n\n/// Build the initial streaming message activity.\npub fn build_initial_activity(text: &str, reply_to: Option<&str>) -> serde_json::Value {\n    let mut activity = serde_json::json!({\n        \"type\": \"message\",\n        \"text\": text,\n    });\n    if let Some(reply_id) = reply_to {\n        activity[\"replyToId\"] = serde_json::Value::String(reply_id.to_string());\n    }\n    activity\n}\n\n/// Build an activity update payload for editing an existing message.\npub fn build_update_activity(\n    activity_id: &str,\n    text: &str,\n) -> serde_json::Value {\n    debug!(activity_id, text_len = text.len(), \"building stream update\");\n    serde_json::json!({\n        \"type\": \"message\",\n        \"id\": activity_id,\n        \"text\": text,\n    })\n}\n\n#[cfg(test)]\nmod tests {\n    use super::*;\n\n    #[test]\n    fn session_lifecycle() {\n        let mut session = StreamSession::new(Duration::from_millis(100));\n\n        // Initially not ready.\n        assert!(!session.ready_for_initial_post());\n        assert!(!session.ready_for_edit());\n        assert!(!session.has_text());\n\n        // Push some text.\n        session.push_delta(\"Hello, this is a test message\");\n        assert!(session.ready_for_initial_post());\n        assert!(session.has_text());\n\n        // Set activity ID (initial post done).\n        session.set_activity_id(\"act-123\".into());\n        assert!(!session.ready_for_initial_post());\n        assert_eq!(session.activity_id(), Some(\"act-123\"));\n\n        // Not ready for edit yet (throttle).\n        assert!(!session.ready_for_edit());\n\n        // After throttle period.\n        session.last_edit = Some(Instant::now() - Duration::from_millis(200));\n        assert!(session.ready_for_edit());\n\n        // Text with suffix.\n        let text = session.text_with_suffix();\n        assert!(text.ends_with(\" ...\"));\n\n        // Finalize.\n        session.finalize();\n        assert!(session.is_finalized());\n        assert!(!session.ready_for_edit());\n        assert!(!session.final_text().ends_with(\" ...\"));\n    }\n\n    #[test]\n    fn initial_activity_with_reply() )\n        };\n\n        // Graph API requires a separate token; we reuse the bot token which\n        // may or may not have Graph permissions depending on the app registration.\n        let limit == 0 {\n            config.history_limit\n        } else {\n            limit.min(config.history_limit)\n        };\n\n        let messages =\n            crate::graph::fetch_chat_messages(&http, &token, channel_id, effective_limit)\n                .await\n                .map_err(|e| {\n                    ChannelError::external(\n };\n            Ok(ChannelHealthSnapshot {\n                connected: true,\n                account_id: state.account_id.clone(),\n                details: Some(details),\n            })\n        } ## Implementation Summary

### New Files Created (8 modules, ~1,400 LOC)

| File | LOC | Purpose |
|------|-----|---------|
| `crates/msteams/src/errors.rs` | ~200 | Error classification (auth/throttled/transient/permanent) and retry delay computation with exponential backoff |
| `crates/msteams/src/chunking.rs` | ~130 | Message text chunking at configurable limit (default 4000 chars), splits at paragraph/line/space boundaries |
| `crates/msteams/src/cards.rs` | ~170 | Adaptive Card builders: welcome cards with prompt starters, poll cards, generic card activities |
| `crates/msteams/src/jwt.rs` | ~250 | Bot Framework JWT validation with JWKS caching, dual issuer support (Bot Framework + Entra) |
| `crates/msteams/src/graph.rs` | ~240 | Microsoft Graph API client: message history, reactions (add/remove/list) |
| `crates/msteams/src/attachments.rs` | ~215 | Inbound attachment downloads, outbound inline image (base64) and URL attachments |
| `crates/msteams/src/streaming.rs` | ~170 | Edit-in-place streaming session management with throttled updates |

### Files Modified (10 files)

| File | Changes |
|------|---------|
| `Cargo.toml` (workspace) | Added `jsonwebtoken = "9"` to workspace dependencies |
| `crates/msteams/Cargo.toml` | Added `jsonwebtoken`, `rand` deps; `tokio` dev-dependency |
| `crates/msteams/src/lib.rs` | Registered 7 new modules |
| `crates/msteams/src/config.rs` | Added ~15 new config fields: `tenant_id`, `max_retries`, `retry_base_delay_ms`, `retry_max_delay_ms`, `stream_mode`, `edit_throttle_ms`, `text_chunk_limit`, `welcome_card`, `group_welcome_card`, `bot_name`, `prompt_starters`, `reply_style`, `teams` (per-team overrides), `graph_tenant_id`, `history_limit`. Added `StreamMode`, `ReplyStyle`, `TeamConfig`, `ChannelOverride` types. Added `resolve_reply_style()` and `resolve_mention_mode()` functions |
| `crates/msteams/src/activity.rs` | Added `attachments`, `members_added`, `members_removed`, `timestamp`, `reply_to_id` fields. Added `team_id()`, `channel_id()`, `bot_was_added()`, `has_downloadable_attachments()` methods |
| `crates/msteams/src/state.rs` | Added `jwt_validator` and `welcomed_conversations` fields |
| `crates/msteams/src/outbound.rs` | Complete rewrite: retry-aware `send_activity_with_retry()` returning activity IDs, `update_activity()` for edits, chunked `send_text_chunked()`, edit-in-place streaming via `send_stream_edit_in_place()`, proper `send_media()` with base64 image and URL attachments, `send_interactive()` via Adaptive Cards, `add_reaction()`/`remove_reaction()` via Graph API |
| `crates/msteams/src/plugin.rs` | JWT validator creation in `start_account()`, `conversationUpdate` handling for welcome cards, attachment downloading, `ChannelThreadContext` implementation for thread history via Graph API, per-team/channel mention mode resolution |
| `crates/channels/src/plugin.rs` | Updated MsTeams descriptor: `supports_interactive: true`, `supports_threads: true`, `supports_reactions: true` |
| `crates/httpd/src/server.rs` | JWT pre-validation before shared-secret check, async webhook processing (spawn + return 202 immediately) |
| `crates/config/src/template.rs` | Documented all new msteams config fields |

### Features Implemented by Priority

**P0 — Critical:**
1. **Webhook timeout handling** — Returns 202 Accepted immediately, processes in background via `tokio::spawn`
2. **Retry with error classification** — Classifies 401/403 (auth), 429 (throttled), 5xx (transient), 4xx (permanent). Exponential backoff with `Retry-After` header support
3. **JWT verification** — JWKS-based validation for Bot Framework and Entra issuers, with 5-minute cache TTL

**P1 — High-value:**
4. **Message chunking** — Splits at ~4000 chars (configurable), preferring paragraph/line/space boundaries
5. **Adaptive Cards** — Welcome cards with prompt starters, poll cards, interactive button messages, generic card sending
6. **File/attachment handling** — Downloads inbound attachments via bot token, sends base64 inline images in DMs, URL attachments for external files
7. **Edit-in-place streaming** — Posts initial message after 20 chars, throttled edits every 1.5s (configurable), final edit on completion

**P2 — Nice to have:**
8. **Thread context via Graph API** — `ChannelThreadContext` implementation fetching chat history
9. **Reactions support** — `add_reaction()`/`remove_reaction()` via Graph API beta endpoints (like, heart, laugh, surprised, sad, angry)
10. **Per-channel config overrides** — `teams.<teamId>.channels.<channelId>` with `mention_mode`, `reply_style`, `model`, `model_provider` overrides

### Test Coverage
- **70 tests total** across all modules (was 18 before)
- All pass, clippy clean, fmt clean, full workspace compiles

## COMPREHENSIVE MOLTIS VS OPENCLAW TEAMS IMPLEMENTATION GAP ANALYSIS

Based on thorough examination of both codebases, here are ALL remaining functional gaps:

---

### **CRITICAL GAPS (High Priority)**

#### **1. Message Search Functionality**
**What OpenClaw does:** Implements `searchMessagesMSTeams()` for full-text search across chat/channel history via Graph API
- Uses `$search` OData parameter for body content search
- Supports filtering by sender (from parameter)
- Configurable limit (default 25, max 50)
- Returns: `SearchMessagesMSTeamsResult { messages: [...] }`
- **API**: `GET /teams/{id}/channels/{id}/messages?$search="query"&$filter=from/user/displayName eq 'name'&$top=25`

**Moltis status:** NOT IMPLEMENTED - no search capability exists

**Criticality:** HIGH - Core feature for agent context building and conversation analysis

---

#### **2. Member Information Lookup**
**What OpenClaw does:** Implements `getMemberInfoMSTeams()` to fetch user profiles from Microsoft Graph

#### **3. File Consent Card Flow (Large File Uploads)**
**What OpenClaw does:** Implements sophisticated file handling for personal chats:
- **Threshold-based routing**: 
  - Files < 4MB in personal chats: base64 inline
  - Files >= 4MB in personal chats: FileConsentCard flow
  - Non-image files in personal chats: FileConsentCard flow
  - Group chats/channels: SharePoint or OneDrive upload
- **FileConsentCard**: Prompts user for upload approval before processing
- `requiresFileConsent()` logic and `prepareFileConsentActivity()` helpers
- Pending upload store with `storePendingUpload(uploadId)`

**Moltis status:** Partially implemented

**Criticality:** HIGH - Without this, agents cannot reliably send documents/large media in personal chats

**What OpenClaw does:** Implements two parallel upload paths:
- **OneDrive**: `uploadAndShareOneDrive()` for personal/fallback use
- **SharePoint**: `uploadAndShareSharePoint()` for group chats and channels
- Creates sharing links with scope control (organization/anonymous)
- Gets driveItem properties for native Teams file card rendering
- **APIs**:
  - `PUT /me/drive/root:/{path}:/content` (OneDrive)
  - `PUT /sites/{siteId}/drive/root:/{path}:/content` (SharePoint)
  - `POST /me/drive/items/{id}/createLink` (sharing)
  - `GET /sites/{siteId}/drive/items/{itemId}` (properties)

     8→const GRAPH_API_BASE: &str = "https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0";
     9→const GRAPH_API_BETA: &str = "https://graph.microsoft.com/beta";
    10→
    11→/// A message from the Graph API.
    12→#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    13→pub struct GraphMessage {
    14→    pub id: String,
    15→    pub body_content: Option<String>,
    16→    pub from_user_id: Option<String>,
    17→    pub from_user_name: Option<String>,
    18→    pub is_bot: bool,

    22→/// Summary of reactions on a message.
    23→#[derive(Debug, Clone)]
    24→pub struct ReactionSummary {
    25→    pub reaction_type: String,
    26→    pub user_name: Option<String>,
    27→}
    28→
    29→/// Valid Teams reaction types.
    30→pub const TEAMS_REACTION_TYPES: &[&str] = &["like", "heart", "laugh", "surprised", "sad", "angry"];
    31→
    32→/// Fetch recent messages from a chat via Graph API.
    33→pub async fn fetch_chat_messages(
    34→    http: &reqwest::Client,
    35→    token: &secrecy::Secret<String>,
    36→    chat_id: &str,
    37→    limit: usize,
    38→) -> anyhow::Result<Vec<GraphMessage>> {
    39→    let url = format!(
    40→        "{GRAPH_API_BASE}/chats/{}/messages?$top={limit}&$orderby=createdDateTime desc",
    41→        urlencoding::encode(chat_id),
    42→    );
    43→
    44→    let resp = http
    45→        .get(&url)
    46→        .bearer_auth(token.expose_secret())
    47→        .send()
    48→        .await?;
    49→
    50→    if !resp.status().is_success() {
    51→        let status = resp.status();
    52→        let body = resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
    53→        anyhow::bail!("Graph API fetch messages failed ({status}): {body}");
    54→    }
    55→
    56→    let json: serde_json::Value = resp.json().await?;
    57→    let messages = json["value"]
    58→        .as_array()
    59→        .map(|arr| arr.iter().filter_map(parse_graph_message).collect())
    60→        .unwrap_or_default();
    61→
    62→    Ok(messages)
    63→}
    64→
    65→/// Add a reaction to a message via Graph API (beta).
    66→pub async fn add_reaction(
    67→    http: &reqwest::Client,

   176→fn parse_graph_message(msg: &serde_json::Value) -> Option<GraphMessage> {
   177→    let id = msg["id"].as_str()?.to_string();
   178→    let body_content = msg["body"]["content"].as_str().map(String::from);
   179→    let from = &msg["from"];
   180→    let from_user_id = from["user"]["id"].as_str().map(String::from);
   181→    let from_user_name = from["user"]["displayName"]
   182→        .as_str()
   183→        .or_else(|| from["application"]["displayName"].as_str())
   184→        .map(String::from);
   185→    let is_bot = from["application"].is_object();
   186→    let created_at = msg["createdDateTime"].as_str().map(String::from);
   187→
   188→    Some(GraphMessage {
   189→        id,
   190→        body_content,
   191→        from_user_id,
   192→        from_user_name,
   193→        is_bot,
   194→        created_at,
   195→    })
   196→}

     1→//! Adaptive Card builders for Teams messages.
     2→//!
     3→//! Provides constructors for common card types: welcome cards, structured
     4→//! responses, and generic card attachments.
     5→
     6→/// Build an Adaptive Card attachment envelope for Bot Framework activities.
     7→pub fn card_attachment(card: serde_json::Value) -> serde_json::Value {
     8→    serde_json::json!({
     9→        "contentType": "application/vnd.microsoft.card.adaptive",
    10→        "content": card,
    11→    })
    12→}
    13→
    14→/// Build a Bot Framework activity that sends an Adaptive Card.
    15→pub fn card_activity(card: serde_json::Value, fallback_text: Option<&str>) -> serde_json::Value {
    16→    let mut activity = serde_json::json!({
    17→        "type": "message",
    18→        "attachments": [card_attachment(card)],
    19→    });
    20→    if let Some(text) = fallback_text {
    21→        activity["text"] = serde_json::Value::String(text.to_string());
    22→    }
    23→    activity
    24→}
    25→
    26→/// Build a welcome card shown when a user first messages the bot in a DM.
    27→pub fn build_welcome_card(bot_name: &str, prompt_starters: &[String]) -> serde_json::Value {
    28→    let mut body: Vec<serde_json::Value> = vec![serde_json::json!({
    29→        "type": "TextBlock",
    30→        "size": "Medium",
    31→        "weight": "Bolder",
    32→        "text": format!("Welcome to {bot_name}!"),
    33→        "wrap": true,
    34→    })];
    35→
    36→    if !prompt_starters.is_empty() {
    37→        body.push(serde_json::json!({
    38→            "type": "TextBlock",
    39→            "text": "Try one of these to get started:",
    40→            "wrap": true,
    41→            "spacing": "Medium",
    42→        }));
    43→
    44→        for starter in prompt_starters {
    45→            body.push(serde_json::json!({
    46→                "type": "ActionSet",
    47→                "actions": [{
    48→                    "type": "Action.Submit",
    49→                    "title": starter,
    50→                    "data": { "msteams": { "type": "imBack", "value": starter } },
    51→                }],
    52→            }));
    53→        }
    54→    } else {
    55→        body.push(serde_json::json!({
    56→            "type": "TextBlock",
    57→            "text": "Send me a message to get started.",
    58→            "wrap": true,
    59→            "spacing": "Medium",
    60→        }));
    61→    }
    62→

    43→        &self,
    44→        account_id: &str,
    45→        conversation_id: &str,
    46→    ) -> ChannelResult<AccountSnapshot> {
    47→        let accounts = self.accounts.read().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    48→        let state = accounts
    49→            .get(account_id)
    50→            .ok_or_else(|| ChannelError::unknown_account(account_id))?;
    51→        let service_url = {
    52→            let service_urls = state.service_urls.read().unwrap_or_else(|e| e.into_inner());
    53→            service_urls
    54→                .get(conversation_id)
    55→                .cloned()
    56→                .ok_or_else(|| {
    57→                    ChannelError::unavailable(format!(
    58→                        "missing Teams service URL for account '{account_id}' and conversation '{conversation_id}'"
    59→                    ))
    60→                })?
    61→        };
    62→
    63→        Ok(AccountSnapshot {
    64→            config: state.config.clone(),
    65→            http: state.http.clone(),
    66→            token_cache: std::sync::Arc::clone(&state.token_cache),
    67→            service_url,
    68→        })
    69→    }

    71→    /// Send an activity to Teams with retry logic.
    72→    ///
    73→    /// Returns the activity ID from the response, needed for edit-in-place
    74→    /// streaming and message updates.
    75→    pub(crate) async fn send_activity_with_retry(
    76→        &self,
    77→        account_id: &str,
    78→        conversation_id: &str,
    79→        activity: serde_json::Value,
    80→    ) -> ChannelResult<SendOutcome> {
    81→        let snapshot = self.account_snapshot(account_id, conversation_id)?;
    82→        let max_attempts = snapshot.config.max_retries.max(1);
    83→        let base_delay = std::time::Duration::from_millis(snapshot.config.retry_base_delay_ms);
    84→        let max_delay = std::time::Duration::from_millis(snapshot.config.retry_max_delay_ms);
    85→
    86→        let mut last_error = None;
    87→
    88→        for attempt in 1..=max_attempts {
    89→            let token=[REDACTED](&snapshot.http, &snapshot.config, &snapshot.token_cache)
    90→                .await
    91→                .map_err(|e| ChannelError::unavailable(format!("Teams token acquisition: {e}")))?;
    92→
    93→            let url = format!(
    94→                "{}/v3/conversations/{}/activities",
    95→                snapshot.service_url.trim_end_matches('/'),
    96→                urlencoding::encode(conversation_id)
    97→            );
    98→
    99→            let resp = match snapshot
   100→                .http
   101→                .post(&url)
   102→                .bearer_auth(token.expose_secret())
   103→                .json(&activity)
   104→                .send()
   105→                .await
   106→            {
   107→                Ok(r) => r,
   108→                Err(e) => {
   109→                    if attempt < max_attempts {
   110→                        let delay = errors::compute_retry_delay(
   111→                            attempt,
   112→                            &errors::SendErrorClassification {
   113→                                kind: SendErrorKind::Transient,
   114→                                status_code: None,
   115→                                retry_after: None,
   116→                            },
   117→                            base_delay,
   118→                            max_delay,
   119→                        );
   120→                        debug!(
   121→                            account_id,
   122→                            attempt,
   123→                            delay_ms = delay.as_millis(),
   124→                            "Teams send network error, retrying: {e}"
   125→                        );
   126→                        tokio::time::sleep(delay).await;
   127→                        last_error = Some(format!("network error: {e}"));
   128→                        continue;
   129→                    }
   130→                    return Err(ChannelError::external("Teams HTTP send", e));
   131→                },
   132→            };
   133→
   134→            if resp.status().is_success() {
   135→                // Extract activity ID from response.
   136→                let body: serde_json::Value = resp.json().await.unwrap_or(serde_json::Value::Null);
   137→                let activity_id = body["id"].as_str().map(String::from);
   138→
   139→                #[cfg(feature = "metrics")]
   140→                moltis_metrics::counter!(
   141→                    moltis_metrics::channels::MESSAGES_SENT_TOTAL,
   142→                    moltis_metrics::labels::CHANNEL => "msteams"
   143→                )
   144→                .increment(1);
   145→
   146→                return Ok(SendOutcome { activity_id });
   147→            }
   148→
   149→            let status = resp.status();
   150→            let headers = resp.headers().clone();
   151→            let body = resp.text().await.unwrap_or_default();
   152→            let classification = errors::classify_send_error(status, &headers);
   153→
   154→            if !errors::should_retry(classification.kind) || attempt >= max_attempts {
   155→                return Err(ChannelError::external(
   156→                    "Teams send failed",
   157→                    std::io::Error::other(format!("{status}: {body}")),
   158→                ));
   159→            }
   160→
   161→            let delay =
   162→                errors::compute_retry_delay(attempt, &classification, base_delay, max_delay);
   163→            debug!(
   164→                account_id,
   165→                attempt,
   166→                status = %status,
   167→                delay_ms = delay.as_millis(),
   168→                "Teams send failed, retrying"
   169→            );
   170→            tokio::time::sleep(delay).await;
   171→            last_error = Some(format!("{status}: {body}"));
   172→        }
   173→
   174→        Err(ChannelError::external(
   175→            "Teams send exhausted retries",
   176→            std::io::Error::other(last_error.unwrap_or_default()),
   177→        ))
   178→    }
